subject: general
question: What is the primary function of lysosomes in a cell?

options.text: Production of energy in the form of ATP molecules
Synthesis of proteins and lipids for cell membranes
Digestion of foreign materials and worn-out organelles
Regulation of water and mineral balance within the cytoplasm

solution:
The correct answer is __**Digestion of foreign materials and worn-out organelles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lysosomes** are membrane-bound vesicular structures that function as the **waste disposal system** of the cell by digesting external materials and cellular components.
 
• They are known as **"Suicide Bags"** of the cell because if the cell gets damaged, lysosomes may burst and the **digestive enzymes** can digest their own cell.
